correctness.rationale: Direct normalized Walsh inversion recovers all correlations at Hamming lags zero, one and two; the star difference geometry isolates off-diagonal real Gram entries. For even n, n+1-2wt(b) never vanishes and permits exact diagonal deconvolution. The complete rank follows by counting independent symmetric entries. An induction on Hamming weight with explicitly independent predecessor pairs yields an O(2) congruence and hence conjugate recovery, with a separate complete-Gram proof for n=2. Two sites at distance 3 disprove global recovery for n>=4. The supplied standard-library checker verifies exact integer/rational instances n=2..6, without substituting a finite test for universal proof.

value.rationale: The radius-one Boolean star is a canonical highly localized time-frequency aperture. The result demonstrates generic nonlinear complex-signal recovery modulo unavoidable conjugation despite the exact severely incomplete matrix-sensing rank, identifies the parity mechanism that recovers pointwise intensities, and proves a genuine uniform-to-nonuniform distinction at n=2 versus n>=4. These are motivated structural inverse-problem features, rather than a routine numeric slice.
